cases.name: Status webhooks share one archive topic with linked authors and native times, without new conversations
startup upgrades only bridge callback events, imports available stored Status posts and deduplicates webhook races
a fresh or wildcard webhook installation remains idempotent
image, video and voice Status posts use native media with attributed captions in the feed
Status media uses the authenticated local status endpoint and never an advertised media URL
omitted or expired media keeps its caption and a readable unavailable notice
expired and malformed incoming stories are skipped while already archived posts remain
typing, edits, message actions and reactions in the Status topic cannot publish or send WhatsApp messages
/statuses opens and refreshes the feed from Bifrost DM; /status remains the health command
replying /mute in Status suppresses only that author before media download, preserving chats and archived posts
refresh honors mutes and unmuting resumes new posts without replaying stories skipped while muted
muted-person preferences survive reopening SQLite and resolve aliases with the latest preference winning
muted list supports one-tap unmute and pagination without changing other people’s preferences
mute controls enforce owner, bot, session, chat, topic and expiry; stale buttons cannot undo a later mute
retrying a mute confirmation or unmute callback cannot reverse a newer decision from another chat
Status mute commands require a mapped Status reply and ordinary conversation mute keeps its existing behavior
Status topic clear log preserves posts, while clear all removes only this topic’s recorded posts
sync updates group metadata, existing member bots and missing-bot buttons without WhatsApp writes
an inbox group only renames its topic and never overwrites the shared management group
content-hash picture caching avoids repeated uploads even when signed source URLs rotate
hidden pictures and unavailable descriptions preserve Telegram data
incomplete metadata and failed lookups cannot clear the old roster or group identity
missing group permission yields a scoped grant button while contact metadata can still sync
one contact bot shared across groups is fetched once and LID aliases retain its binding
/sync scopes to its conversation, and global sync uses the local management queue
/sync in a bound member bot DM works without a one-to-one route and reports back through that bot
an unbound member bot explains the missing binding for Start and /sync without accessing WhatsApp
member-bot DM sync keeps the contact scope with an existing inbox topic and rejects global sync
a failed group lookup does not prevent existing contact bots from syncing
chat jobs take priority over metadata work, and coalesced manual requests receive a completion
cron is timezone-aware and persists one run per scheduled minute across restarts
cron supports quarter-hour, daily, weekday and disabled schedules and rejects malformed fields
an unchanged scheduled metadata run completes quietly after a populated group was synchronized
